comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and secures a shock absorber; record cocks a desoldering pump and leaves it ready in a cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses recessed hex-key manipulation, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and iterative cycle testing; record uses spring-loading actuation and placement into a cradle.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two non-bottoming stops without rebound, overload, drift, or damage. Record gives no body, specs, cocking-state test, cradle tolerance, or scoring rubric.
comparison.reason: Cocking and cradling a spring tool tests a different mechanism and terminal state from calibrating an energy absorber.
